detail.title: 4MP 25x Starlight IR WizMind Network Dual-PTZ Camera for Traffic
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SDT5X425-4Z4-FAJG-2812 4MP 25x Starlight IR WizMind Network Dual-PTZ Camera for Traffic Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution for Overview Channel, 4MP for Detailed Channel • 2 Lane Checkpoin Capture with Wrong-Way and Congestion Detection • Supports Monitoring Parking Zones with Multi-Scene Tour and Vehicle Recognition • Support Hi-PoE • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Electronic Shutter Speed: Panorama: 1/3 s–1/100000 s Detail: 1/1 s–1/100000 s
General.Min. Illumination: Panorama: Color: 0.001 Lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0001 Lux@F1.6 Detail: Color: 0.001 Lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0001 Lux@F1.6 0 Lux (IR light on)
General.Illumination Distance: Panorama (white light): 30 m (98.43 ft) Detail (IR light): 100 m (328.08 ft)
General.Illuminator On/Off Control: Panorama: Zoom Prio; Manual; Auto; Off Detail: Zoom Prio; Manual; Auto; Off
General.Illuminator Number: Panorama: 4 white lights Detail: 4 IR lights
General.Focal Length: Panorama: 2.8 mm–12 mm Detail: 5.4 mm–135 mm
General.Close Focus Distance: Panorama: 1 m–2.5 m (3.28 ft–8.20 ft) Detail: 0.5 m–7 m (1.64 ft–22.97 ft)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Panorama: Pan: 0°–360° endless; Tilt: 0°–30° Detail: Pan: 0°–305° (the angle between two cameras: -125° to +180°); Tilt: -10°–180°
General.Manual Control Speed: Panorama: Pan: 0.1°/s–100°/s; Tilt: 0.1°/s–25°/s Detail: Pan: 0.1°/s–400°/s; Tilt: 0.1°/s–200°/s
General.Preset Speed: Panorama: Pan: 100°/s; Tilt: 50°/s Detail: Pan: 360°/s; Tilt: 200°/s
General.Illegal Parking Capture: Capture range radius: 4 m–60 m (13.12 ft–196.85 ft) (panoramic linkage mode), 120 m (393.70 ft) (detail camera); support adaptive multi-scenario tour detection; 2–6 snapshots can be set, and the capture interval can be set between each capturing; snapshot type includes long-distance, medium-distance, close-distance, and plate feature; support vehicle type, color, logo, series, license plate, plate color and other attribute recognition; support panorama-detail linkage capture, and multi-scenario tour; supports panoramic fixed capture, while detail camera capturing illegal parking, and independent multi-scenario tour.
General.Checkpoint Capture: Detects events for up to 2 lanes. Detects wrong-way driving and traffic congestion. Recognizes motor vehicle attributes, including license plates, plate color, vehicle color, and vehicle type.
General.Intelligence Note: ANPR of illegally parked vehicle: Supports adaptively loading its corresponding license plate recognition algorithm according to the area selected; integrate overseas general recognition algorithms to support license plate recognition containing letters and numbers; integrate special license plate recognition algorithm in EU; integrate Singapore and Malaysia special license plate recognition algorithms; integrate special license plate recognition algorithms for UAE, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Oman, Egypt, Iraq, and Jordan
General.Video Frame Rate: Panoramic: Main stream: 4M/1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p/CIF (1–25/30 fps) Detail: Main stream: 4M/1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p/CIF (1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 512 Kbps–13056 Kbps H.265: 204 Kbps–7936 Kbps
General.White Balance: Panorama: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp Detail: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Certification: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB,ANSI C63.4- 2014"
General.Audio Compression: PCM; G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; AAC; MPEG2-Layer2; G722.1; G729
General.Browser: IE9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions Safari 10 and later versions
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 21 W Max.: 40 W (PTZ, zoom, focus, IR light, white light, and smart plan enabled)
General.Protection: IP67; IK10; TVS 8000 V lightning protection; surge protection; voltage transient protection
